visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Reversal Off by One
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Rotating 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 left by 3 should give 4 5 6 7 1 2 3, but the program prints 7 4 5 6 1 2 3.

solution.explanation: Rotating by k with three reversals needs the second reversal to cover positions k through n - 1. Stopping at n - 2 leaves the last element out of its block, so it is carried to the front by the final full reversal.
